# ---- Baseline rules: what is taken out (Jan 2026-11-08: no history, a blacklist) ----

# Location scope: the food one unit of peasants eats more (bad harvest) or less (good harvest) a month this year:
# the peasant food consumption of the location's Variable Harvest modifier x the peasants' food per head
# (1). 0 in a normal year.
pp_cplan_harvest_rate = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sub_continent = sub_continent:australasia }
		if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_harvest_australasia_abysmal } value = 0.3 }
		else_if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_harvest_australasia_very_poor } value = 0.2 }
		else_if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_harvest_australasia_poor } value = 0.11 }
		else_if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_harvest_australasia_good } value = -0.11 }
		else_if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_harvest_australasia_very_good } value = -0.2 }
		else_if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_harvest_australasia_bountiful } value = -0.3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sub_continent = sub_continent:central_africa }
		if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_harvest_central_africa_abysmal } value = 0.3 }
		else_if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_harvest_central_africa_very_poor } value = 0.2 }
		else_if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_harvest_central_africa_poor } value = 0.11 }

# Location scope: market access without the event modifiers of [construction_plan] access_blacklist.
pp_cplan_access_normal = {
	value = market_access
	if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = staple_port_commercial_stagnation_modifier } subtract = -0.25 }
}

# ---- Farms: which line pays back fastest here (location scope, its market) ----
# A level's monthly profit at this market's prices and this location's output: each slot's best method
# (production efficiency, staffing and market access left out: the same for every line here). Its yearly
# return in % of the tier's base price (pp_cplan_farm_roi_<tier>); a line's return is that of its highest tier
# that can be built here (a standing older tier is replaced once its successor is researched).

pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_1_1 = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:wheat)" multiply = { value = modifier:local_wheat_output_modifier add = 1 min = 0 } multiply = 0.06 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:manual_labor)" multiply = 0.012 }
}
pp_cplan_fs_wheat_farm_1 = {
	value = pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_1_1
}
pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_2_1 = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:wheat)" multiply = { value = modifier:local_wheat_output_modifier add = 1 min = 0 } multiply = 0.15 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:livestock)" multiply = 0.037 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:lumber)" multiply = 0.021 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:manual_labor)" multiply = 0.024 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:tools)" multiply = 0.002 }
}
pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_2_2 = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:wheat)" multiply = { value = modifier:local_wheat_output_modifier add = 1 min = 0 } multiply = 0.166 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:horses)" multiply = 0.016 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:lumber)" multiply = 0.029 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:manual_labor)" multiply = 0.026 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:tools)" multiply = 0.003 }
}
pp_cplan_fs_wheat_farm_2 = {
	value = pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_2_1
	min = pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_2_2
	min = 0
}
pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_3_1 = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:local_food)" multiply = { value = modifier:local_local_food_output_modifier add = 1 min = 0 } multiply = 1.5 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:wheat)" multiply = 0.01 }
}
pp_cplan_fs_wheat_farm_3 = {
	value = pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_3_1
}
pp_cplan_farm_est_wheat_farm = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { market ?= { always = yes } }
		add = pp_cplan_fs_wheat_farm_1
		add = pp_cplan_fs_wheat_farm_2
		add = pp_cplan_fs_wheat_farm_3
	}
}
pp_cplan_farm_roi_wheat_farm = {
	value = pp_cplan_farm_est_wheat_farm
	multiply = 1200
	divide = { value = building_type:wheat_farm.building_base_cost_in_gold min = 1 }
}

# Location scope: the wheat line's return here (0 where no tier can be built).
pp_cplan_farm_line_roi_wheat = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = wheat_model_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:wheat_model_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_wheat_model_farm
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = wheat_rotations } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:wheat_rotations building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_wheat_rotations
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = wheat_farmstead } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:wheat_farmstead building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_wheat_farmstead
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = wheat_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:wheat_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_wheat_farm
	}
}

		add = pp_cplan_fs_millet_farm_3

# Location scope: the millet line's return here (0 where no tier can be built).
pp_cplan_farm_line_roi_millet = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = millet_model_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:millet_model_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_millet_model_farm
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = millet_rotations } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:millet_rotations building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_millet_rotations
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = millet_farmstead } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:millet_farmstead building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_millet_farmstead
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = millet_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:millet_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_millet_farm
	}
}

# Location scope: the legume line's return here (0 where no tier can be built).
pp_cplan_farm_line_roi_legume = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = legume_model_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:legume_model_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_legume_model_farm
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = legume_rotations } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:legume_rotations building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_legume_rotations
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = legume_farmstead } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:legume_farmstead building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_legume_farmstead
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = legume_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:legume_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_legume_farm
	}
}

# Location scope: the forest_village line's return here (0 where no tier can be built).
pp_cplan_farm_line_roi_forest_village = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = managed_forest_village } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:managed_forest_village building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_managed_forest_village
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = forest_village } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:forest_village building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_forest_village
	}
}

# ---- Improvements (location scope): capacity a level adds per 1,000 gold of its price here ----
# (base price x (1 + increase_per_level_cost x the levels standing); the location's build efficiency and the
# construction goods are the same for every improvement here)

	value = 5000
	divide = {

		multiply = 0.05
		add = 1
		multiply = building_type:bund.building_base_cost_in_gold
		min = 1
	}
}

# ---- Businesses (location scope, its market): a level's monthly profit and yearly return ----
# pp_cplan_bm_<type>_<slot>_<method>: one method's profit (goods made at the market's price x the location's
# output without this year's harvest, minus its inputs at the market's prices); pp_cplan_bs_*: the slot's best;
# pp_cplan_bz_est_<type>: the level's profit; pp_cplan_bz_roi_<type>: x 12 over its build cost, in %
# (scope:pp_cplan_btype and the cost data set by pp_cplan_business_pick).

pp_cplan_bm_ablaq_palace_1_1 = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:silk)" multiply = { value = modifier:local_silk_output_modifier add = 1 subtract = scope:pp_cplan_hv_silk min = 0 } multiply = 0.35 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:lumber)" multiply = 0.12 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:manual_labor)" multiply = 0.32 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:marble)" multiply = 0.16 }
}
pp_cplan_bs_ablaq_palace_1 = {
	value = pp_cplan_bm_ablaq_palace_1_1
}

	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:offset)" multiply = 0.015 }
}

pp_cplan_bm_winery_manufactory_1_5 = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:wine)" multiply = { value = modifier:local_wine_output_modifier add = 1 subtract = scope:pp_cplan_hv_wine min = 0 } multiply = 1.5 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:lumber)" multiply = 0.27 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:manual_labor)" multiply = 0.63 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:rice)" multiply = 1.46 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:tools)" multiply = 0.078 }
}

# ---- The market limit (construction_plan.py render_market) ----
# pp_cplan_uc_here_<good> (location scope): the monthly output of the good the levels under construction here
# will add (the buildings whose main good it is, at their recipe's output a level);
# pp_cplan_uc_market_<good> (market scope): the same over the market's locations with a construction;
# pp_cplan_mroom_<good> (the market's centre location): the output of the good that may still start = the
# market's monthly demand x pp_cplan_market_share minus what is under construction (pp_cplan_uc_<good>, + 100,
# kept on that location for the pass by pp_cplan_market_load; a market scope holds no variables).

pp_cplan_uc_here_alum = {
	value = 0
	every_buildings_in_location = {
		limit = { building_levels_under_construction > 0 building_type = building_type:alum_quarry }
		add = { value = building_levels_under_construction multiply = 0.51 }
	}
	every_buildings_in_location = {
		limit = { building_levels_under_construction > 0 building_type = building_type:alum_works }
		add = { value = building_levels_under_construction multiply = 0.758 }
	}
}
pp_cplan_uc_market_alum = {
	value = 0
	every_location_in_market = {
		limit = { num_civil_constructions > 0 }
		add = pp_cplan_uc_here_alum
	}
}
pp_cplan_mroom_alum = {
	value = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:alum)"
	multiply = pp_cplan_market_share
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_uc_alum }
		subtract = { value = var:pp_cplan_uc_alum subtract = 100 }
	}
}

# ---- Budgets that save (country scope; pp_cplan_purses_fill, pp_cplan_purses_hand_on) ----
# pp_cplan_purse_<why> (+ 100): the gold a rule group has saved. The values below are functions of the state as
# it stands; the two effects read them all before they write.

# The gold above the reserve the purses may hold.
pp_cplan_purse_free = {
	value = pp_cplan_free_gold
	min = 0
}

# what it keeps at the pass's start: nothing while it does not count (its weight 0, or nothing to do)

	if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_profiles_cw > 0 }
		value = pp_cplan_purse_n_105
	}

		}
		value = 1
	}
}

			NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_save_cost_105 }
		}
		value = 1
	}

# The pass's start.
# What the purses hold together, without the groups that do not count.
pp_cplan_purse_held = {
	value = 0
	add = pp_cplan_purse_kept_105
	add = pp_cplan_purse_kept_101
	add = pp_cplan_purse_kept_102
	add = pp_cplan_purse_kept_106
	add = pp_cplan_purse_kept_103
	add = pp_cplan_purse_kept_107
}
# The gold above the reserve that is in no purse yet (0 when the purses hold more than there is).
pp_cplan_purse_rest = {
	value = pp_cplan_purse_free
	subtract = pp_cplan_purse_held
	min = 0
}
# profiles: its part of the gold in no purse, and its purse after the pass's start (shrunk like every purse
# when they hold more than the gold above the reserve)
pp_cplan_purse_new_105 = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_w_total > 0 }
		value = pp_cplan_purse_rest
		multiply = pp_cplan_profiles_cw
		divide = pp_cplan_w_total
	}
}
pp_cplan_purse_next_105 = {
	value = pp_cplan_purse_kept_105
	if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_purse_held > pp_cplan_purse_free }
		multiply = pp_cplan_purse_free
		divide = pp_cplan_purse_held
	}
	add = pp_cplan_purse_new_105
}
# food: its part of the gold in no purse, and its purse after the pass's start (shrunk like every purse
# when they hold more than the gold above the reserve)
pp_cplan_purse_new_101 = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_w_total > 0 }
		value = pp_cplan_purse_rest
		multiply = pp_cplan_food_w
		divide = pp_cplan_w_total
	}
}

}

# The pass's end.
# The gold of the groups that hand on, and the weights of the groups that save.
pp_cplan_hand_pool = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = pp_cplan_purse_n_105 multiply = pp_cplan_gives_105 }
	add = { value = pp_cplan_purse_n_101 multiply = pp_cplan_gives_101 }
	add = { value = pp_cplan_purse_n_102 multiply = pp_cplan_gives_102 }
	add = { value = pp_cplan_purse_n_106 multiply = pp_cplan_gives_106 }
	add = { value = pp_cplan_purse_n_103 multiply = pp_cplan_gives_103 }
	add = { value = pp_cplan_purse_n_107 multiply = pp_cplan_gives_107 }
}
pp_cplan_hand_weights = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = pp_cplan_profiles_cw multiply = pp_cplan_saves_105 }
	add = { value = pp_cplan_food_w multiply = pp_cplan_saves_101 }
	add = { value = pp_cplan_logistics_w multiply = pp_cplan_saves_102 }
	add = { value = pp_cplan_improve_w multiply = pp_cplan_saves_106 }
	add = { value = pp_cplan_business_w multiply = pp_cplan_saves_103 }
	add = { value = pp_cplan_country_cw multiply = pp_cplan_saves_107 }
}
# profiles: what it gets from the groups that hand on, and its purse after the hand-on
pp_cplan_hand_get_105 = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			pp_cplan_saves_105 > 0
			pp_cplan_hand_weights > 0
		}
		value = pp_cplan_hand_pool
		multiply = pp_cplan_profiles_cw
		divide = pp_cplan_hand_weights
	}
}
pp_cplan_hand_next_105 = {
	value = pp_cplan_purse_n_105
	if = {
		limit = {
			pp_cplan_gives_105 > 0
			pp_cplan_hand_weights > 0
		}
		value = 0
	}
	add = pp_cplan_hand_get_105
}

# ---- The window's detail panes (country scope; pp_cplan_stats_reset_<why>, pp_cplan_history_push) ----

# profiles (construction code 105)
pp_cplan_d_profiles_ran = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_dran_105 }
		value = 1
	}
}
pp_cplan_d_profiles_had = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_dhad_105 }
		value = var:pp_cplan_dhad_105
		subtract = 100
	}
}
pp_cplan_d_profiles_spent = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_dspent_105 }
		value = var:pp_cplan_dspent_105
		subtract = 100
	}
}
pp_cplan_d_profiles_started = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_dn_105 }
		value = var:pp_cplan_dn_105
		subtract = 100
	}
}
pp_cplan_d_profiles_wait = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_dwait_105 }
		value = var:pp_cplan_dwait_105
		subtract = 100
	}
}
pp_cplan_d_profiles_waitn = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_dwn_105 }
		value = var:pp_cplan_dwn_105
		subtract = 100
	}
}
pp_cplan_d_profiles_goods = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_dgo_105 }
		value = var:pp_cplan_dgo_105
		subtract = 100
	}
}
pp_cplan_d_profiles_limited = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_dml_105 }
		value = var:pp_cplan_dml_105
		subtract = 100
	}
}
pp_cplan_d_profiles_need = {
	value = pp_cplan_d_profiles_spent
	add = pp_cplan_d_profiles_wait
}
pp_cplan_d_profiles_locs = {
	value = 0
	if = {
